data.title: Ethereum rises 2.25% to $2,471 amid strong Augu... | Pluang
data.description: Ethereum's price increased by 2.25% to $2,471.16, following a strong 32.8% gain in August. The price remains above key technical support at $2,247.57, signaling bullish momentum, while resistance sits near $2,783.71. A large whale moved over 102,000 ETH, partly sending some to exchanges, which could influence selling pressure. Ethereum's derivatives market shows high activity with open interest surpassing $30 billion and trading volume over $90 billion, indicating strong trader interest as the market watches key price levels for the next move.
data.author: Blockonomi
